label: Wind speed at 2 m
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)

label: Wind speed at 10 m
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)

label: Strongest hourly wind at 10 m
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
notes: Maximum hourly 10 m wind speed in the month (storm/dust-wind proxy).

label: Hottest hour of the month (2 m)
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
notes: Single highest hourly 2 m air temperature in the month.

label: Precipitation (MERRA-2 bias-corrected)
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
notes: POWER gives mm/day; multiplied by days in month.

label: Aerosol optical depth 550 nm (dust/smoke haze)
source: CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER (parameter AOD_55)
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
notes: Column aerosol optical depth; high values in the dry season reflect Saharan dust and biomass burning.

label: Aerosol optical depth 840 nm
source: CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER (parameter AOD_84)
aggregation: value of the POWER grid cell containing the county centroid (centroid sampling; grid cells are ~county-sized or larger)
notes: Longer-wavelength AOD; relatively more sensitive to coarse dust than to smoke.
